name: editor
description: Integer, orthogonal, path-only SVG editing library for synoptic-view symbols.

scripts.build: npm run deps:audit && vite build && cargo run --release -q -p declarations -- src dist/types
scripts.fix: cargo run --release -q -p format -- --write "*" .cargo .agents .claude/settings.json .githooks .github docs playground scripts src tests tools && oxlint --fix --deny-warnings --report-unused-disable-directives-severity=error *.ts docs playground scripts src tests && cargo run --release -q -p lint -- --fix *.ts *.md .agents .github docs playground scripts src tests && { [ -z "$(git status --porcelain -- '*.rs' '*Cargo.toml' Cargo.lock)" ] || cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked --quiet --fix --allow-dirty --allow-staged; } && cargo fmt --all
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked --quiet && npm run --silent rust:advisories && cargo check --workspace --all-targets --locked --quiet --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc && npm run --silent rust:fresh
scripts.check:all: cargo run --release -q -p heavy-lock -- cargo run --release -q -p repo-tools --bin check-all
scripts.test:timings: cargo run --release -q -p heavy-lock -- vitest run --tags-filter=timing playground/hover/helps-on-any-color.test.ts playground/listeners/remove-listeners.test.ts playground/mount/mount-playground.test.ts src/io/font-face/parse-font-face.test.ts src/math/sequence/scan.test.ts src/model/text-wrap/without-trailing-spaces.test.ts src/model/text-wrap/wrapped-paragraph.test.ts tests/history-timings.test.ts
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings --report-unused-disable-directives-severity=error *.ts docs playground scripts src tests && cargo run --release -q -p lint -- *.ts *.md .agents .github docs playground scripts src tests
scripts.format:check: cargo run --release -q -p format -- --check "*" .cargo .agents .claude/settings.json .githooks .github docs playground scripts src tests tools
scripts.docs:api: cargo run --release -q -p api-pages -- src/index.ts docs/api /api/ editor
scripts.docs:dev: npm run docs:api && vitepress dev docs
scripts.docs:build: cargo run --release -q -p heavy-lock -- sh -c "npm run docs:api && vitepress build docs"
scripts.rust:coverage: cargo llvm-cov --version > /dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'cargo-llvm-cov is missing: rustup installs llvm-tools from rust-toolchain.toml, then run cargo install --locked cargo-llvm-cov@0.9.1 (docs/tooling/commands.md)' >&2; exit 1; }; cargo llvm-cov --workspace --locked --quiet --summary-only --fail-under-lines 95 --fail-under-functions 95 || { echo 'Rust tests failed, or their coverage fell under the floor of 95 % of lines and 95 % of functions (docs/tooling/commands.md)' >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.rust:advisories: cargo deny --version > /dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'cargo-deny is missing: run cargo install --locked cargo-deny@0.20.2, then cargo deny fetch db (docs/tooling/commands.md)' >&2; exit 1; }; cargo deny --offline check advisories || { echo 'A Rust crate has a RustSec advisory, or the advisory database is missing: cargo deny fetch db fetches it (docs/tooling/commands.md)' >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.mutate: cargo run --release -q -p heavy-lock -- cargo run --release -q -p mutate --
scripts.golden:check: cargo run --release -q -p heavy-lock -- vitest run tests/golden-results.test.ts --mode golden-check
scripts.story:finish: cargo run --release -q -p heavy-lock -- --lock merge cargo run --release -q -p repo-tools --bin story-finish --
